+import attr
+
+
+def test_comparison_keys_flow_to_generated_methods():
+    def transform(cls, attrs):
+        return [a.evolve(eq=abs, order=lambda v: -abs(v)) for a in attrs]
+
+    @attr.s(order=True, unsafe_hash=True, field_transformer=transform)
+    class C:
+        x = attr.ib()
+
+    f = attr.fields(C).x
+    assert f.eq is True
+    assert f.eq_key is abs
+    assert f.order is True
+    assert callable(f.order_key)
+    assert C(-3) == C(3)
+    assert hash(C(-3)) == hash(C(3))
+    assert C(4) < C(3)
+
+
+def test_boolean_changes_clear_only_the_changed_key():
+    @attr.s
+    class C:
+        x = attr.ib(eq=abs, order=abs)
+
+    f = attr.fields(C).x
+    for flag in (True, False):
+        e = f.evolve(eq=flag)
+        assert e.eq is flag
+        assert e.eq_key is None
+        assert e.order is True
+        assert e.order_key is abs
+        o = f.evolve(order=flag)
+        assert o.order is flag
+        assert o.order_key is None
+        assert o.eq is True
+        assert o.eq_key is abs
+    e = f.evolve(name="y")
+    assert e.eq_key is abs
+    assert e.order_key is abs
+    assert f.eq_key is abs

spec.question: Extend Attribute.evolve so changes supplied through eq and order understand the same boolean-or-key-callable distinction as field declarations. A callable eq change must enable equality and become eq_key; a callable order change must enable ordering and become order_key. A True or False change must set that inclusion flag and clear its corresponding key. Changing one option must not change the other option or its key, and evolving unrelated metadata must preserve both keys. This request concerns boolean and callable eq/order changes, not new semantics for None or explicitly supplied eq_key/order_key. The resulting metadata must work when returned by a field transformer, including generated equality, ordering, and hashing.
